competitors.name: Alpha School
strengths: Strong brand recognition in micro-school space
2-hour learning model is compelling marketing pitch
weaknesses: No AI backbone — uses generic off-the-shelf curriculum
No adaptive assessment or personalized learning paths
Cookie-cutter approach does not adjust to individual student needs
No immersive or game-based learning experiences
No university-grade content integration
competitors.qluu_differentiator: University School's XP Engine uses Gemma 4 multimodal AI to transform actual university lectures into personalized branching narrative RPGs. Alpha School uses static, non-adaptive curriculum. Our Productive Failure pedagogy drives 20-40% higher retention vs. passive instruction.

competitors.name: Synthesis
weaknesses: No university alignment or course credit pathway
Limited to math and structured problem solving
No branching narrative or RPG engagement
No local-first AI — relies on cloud processing
No franchise/micro-school model
competitors.qluu_differentiator: University School provides a full curriculum pathway from K-12 through dual enrollment college credit (ASU Online, Berkeley). Synthesis is limited to enrichment math. Our local-first Gemma 4 architecture ensures zero data leaves the student's machine.

competitors.name: Prenda
weaknesses: No AI-powered adaptive learning
No immersive or game-based experiences
Relies on facilitator quality — inconsistent outcomes
No technology differentiation
No university content integration
competitors.qluu_differentiator: University School automates curriculum generation from university lecture content using AI, removing Prenda's dependency on facilitator expertise. Our 3D immersive worlds (Cesium + Google Photorealistic Tiles) and RPG branching narratives provide engagement that Prenda's text-based approach cannot match.

competitors.name: Khanmigo
strengths: Massive existing user base via Khan Academy
weaknesses: Cloud-dependent — student data processed by OpenAI
No branching narrative or RPG mechanics
No Productive Failure pedagogy — immediately corrects errors
No immersive 3D world visualization
Reactive tutoring only — does not proactively design misconception experiences
Cannot process custom university lecture videos
No franchise model or micro-school analytics
competitors.qluu_differentiator: Khanmigo corrects errors immediately — the pedagogically inferior approach. University School's XP Engine deliberately designs wrong paths that create memorable correction experiences (Productive Failure), backed by research showing 20-40% better retention. Additionally, our Gemma 4 backbone runs fully local — no student data ever touches OpenAI's cloud.

market_positioning.primary_claim: Only EdTech platform combining Productive Failure branching narratives with local-first multimodal AI and university-grade content ingestion.
secondary_claims: Zero-cloud AI architecture — FERPA/COPPA compliant by design
Transforms actual university lectures into playable RPG missions
3D immersive historical environments using real-world photogrammetry
